name: data-mark
title: Data mark
summary: An item in a timeline, a track or a chart whose hue names its kind.
use: For marks people read by kind at a glance: clips by media type, tracks, chart series.

options.name: hue
options.description: The kind of thing; the same hue everywhere for the same kind.

rules: The one place a hue tints a fill, and only at 16% over surface.
Words stay ink and name what the hue means.
Selection is an ink edge, never the accent.
accessibility: The mark's label names its kind; color never carries it alone.
